source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style

steps.instruction: Wash 6 medium potatoes and cut them in half.
Put the potatoes in a saucepan of cold water.
Cover and cook over medium heat for 25 minutes, until tender.
steps.spoken: Cover and cook over medium heat for 25 to thirty minutes, until the potatoes are tender.

steps.instruction: Drain the potatoes and let them cool.
Add 2 chopped celery stalks, 2 chopped scallions and 1 tablespoon of chopped onion.
Add 1/4 cup each of red bell pepper and green bell pepper, coarsely chopped.
Add 1 chopped hard-boiled egg and toss.
In a small bowl, blend 6 tablespoons of mayonnaise and 1 teaspoon of mustard.
Blend in 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1/4 teaspoon of pepper and 1/4 teaspoon of dill weed.
Pour the dressing over the potato mixture and stir gently to coat.
Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.
